title: Adaptive intake windows and commitment ledger for top-account bursts
creator: Priya Singh
description: Design a signal-driven intake system that opens short-duration 'admit windows' for high-priority customers and records accepted scope in a lightweight commitment ledger. The goal is to reduce lead time for high-touch requests while protecting engineering velocity and contractual commitments. This ticket covers product definition, acceptance heuristics, SLA SLOs, and a rollout plan that includes a canary with 3 pilot accounts.
acceptance_criteria: Define admission signal set: account_priority, ARR_band, active_incidents, recent_usage_spike, executive_escalation flag.
Expose three configurable admit window types: Immediate (<=72h), Near-term (1-4 weeks), and Deferred (next cycle).
Commitment ledger stores: accepted_scope_summary, delivery_window, owner, rollback_triggers, and optional partial_deliverables policy.
UI in Console: intake card for admitted requests showing ledger entry, outstanding deliverables, and rollback options.
APIs: POST /intake/admit and GET /intake/ledger with RBAC tied to account tier.
Create monitoring: time-to-ack, time-to-schedule, engineering_lead_time, and breach_rate metrics with alerts.
Canary: run with 3 pilot accounts for 6 weeks, success = <=15% escalation reopens and delivery within committed windows for >=80% of entries.
milestones: 2025-03-10: API surface and ledger schema finalized
2025-03-24: engineering implementation and infra capacity reservations
2025-04-15: pilot completion review and go/no-go for broader rollouts
decisions: Prefer ephemeral admit windows to avoid permanent prioritization lanes that starve mid-market customers.
Ledger will be append-only for auditability; edits require creating compensating entries.
Default admit window length will be conservative (48-72h) to protect velocity; product can escalate to near-term with quota checks.
Engineering capacity for admits will be represented as a soft reservation token rather than hard blocking to enable graceful degradation under load.
notes: Legal template for partial_deliverables and rollback triggers in /legal/templates/commitment-ledger-v1.docx
